payload.reason: The re-ranking approach described in the paper operates on a set of pre-existing answer candidates and improves their ranking based on additional information, which aligns with the principles of transductive learning. This method does not require retraining the entire model but rather refines the output based on new data available after deployment.

claims.text: The re-ranking approach improves the performance of deployed QA systems without retraining, indicating a transductive learning technique.
The method uses a separately provided test set for evaluation, which is characteristic of transductive learning where the model adapts to new data.
